# `multipleCatchTag`

Suggests collapsing consecutive Effect.catchTag transformations into a single Effect.catchTags call when semantics stay equivalent

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Style |
| Default severity | `suggestion` |
| Fixable | No |
| Effect versions | v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377092` |
| Language Service name | `multipleCatchTag` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/multiple-catch-tag` |

## Preview

```ts
import { Data, Effect, pipe } from "effect"

class NotFound extends Data.TaggedError("NotFound")<{}> {}
class Unauthorized extends Data.TaggedError("Unauthorized")<{}> {}

declare const program: Effect.Effect<string, NotFound | Unauthorized>

export const preview = pipe(
  program,
  Effect.catchTag("NotFound", () => Effect.succeed("missing")),
/**
  ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ effecttsgo(multiple-catch-tag): These 2 consecutive `catchTag` transformations can be collapsed into a single `catchTags` call.
*/
  Effect.catchTag("Unauthorized", () => Effect.succeed("denied"))
)
```

```jsonc
{
  "$schema": "./node_modules/@effect/tsgo/schema.json",
  "compilerOptions": {

      {
        "name": "@effect/language-service",
        "diagnosticSeverity": {
          "multipleCatchTag": "warning"
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```
